newsitem.title: INDIA: India imposes tax on customs, steamer agents.
newsitem.headline: India imposes tax on customs, steamer agents.

text.p: The Indian government has decided to impose a five percent service tax on customs house and steamer agents, a Finance Ministry official said on Friday.
The ministry later released a statement saying the tax would take effect from June 15.
Finance Minister P. Chidambaram in his 1997/98 (April-March) budget presented in February had pledged to introduce a tax on services.

The Finance Ministry held discussions with trade and industry associations before formulating the tax, the statement said. The modalities of levy and collection of service tax have been formulated based on these discussions, it added.
"The rate of service tax will be 5.0 percent on the gross service charges," the ministry said.
"The value of the taxable service in case of Customs House Agents (CHAs) will be only the service and attendancy charges/fee/commission charged to the customer."
